SI-4.answer: Personalizing progressive changes to brain structure in Alzheimer's disease using normative modeling

NM2-1.detail: A non-Gaussian Bayesian regression model (Warped Bayesian Linear Regression) was used to account for non-Gaussian distributions and adjust for site effects.
NM2-1.supporting_text: A non-Gaussian Bayesian regression model was implemented... This model was trained on 58,836 scans from datasets across 82 sites to generate normative models per region using the covariates age, sex, and site, as previously described. 14,32
NM2-1.location: Verdi2024.pdf.md: 2 METHODS / 2.4 Neuroanatomical normative modeling / Paragraph 1

NM2-2.detail: Cortical thickness of 148 regions and gray matter tissue volume of 20 subcortical volumes were extracted.
NM2-2.supporting_text: T1-weighted scans... were processed using FreeSurfer recon-all cross-sectional, to extract the cortical thickness of 148 cortical regions and gray matter tissue volume of 20 subcortical volumes from the Destrieux parcellations.
NM2-2.location: Verdi2024.pdf.md: 2 METHODS / 2.3 Estimation of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes / Paragraph 1

NM2-3.detail: The normative models were generated using age, sex, and site as covariates.
NM2-3.supporting_text: This model was trained on 58,836 scans... to generate normative models per region using the covariates age, sex, and site
NM2-3.location: Verdi2024.pdf.md: 2 METHODS / 2.4 Neuroanatomical normative modeling / Paragraph 1
